COST: 106

Assumptions: roads can be driven in either direction. Galchhi shelter is the only designated evacuation point, since Panchakanya school has not been designated. The Jwalamukhi road is excluded because its bridge is gone.

Two shopkeepers at Gosaikunda farm are deferred. Rescuing them would need one more 48-minute round trip (cost 48), which is more than the 40 penalty for deferring them.
